description: This file contains internal helper templates and macros for type introspection, callable checks, and equivalence testing within the Abseil C++ library, specifically related to conformance testing helpers.

classes.name: GeneratorType
classes.description: A template struct representing a function object that returns an instance of a type under conformance testing.

classes.name: EquivalenceClassType
classes.description: A template struct representing a collection of generator functions with the same return type, used for conformance testing.

classes.name: OrderedEquivalenceClasses
classes.description: A template struct representing an ordered series of EquivalenceClassType instances, ensuring a logical ascending order for testing.

classes.name: IsNullaryCallableImpl
classes.description: A template struct to check if a functor is callable with no arguments.

classes.name: IsNullaryCallable
classes.description: A wrapper struct to determine if a functor can be called with no arguments.

classes.name: ResultOfGenerator
classes.description: A metafunction to determine the return type of a GeneratorType functor.

classes.name: ResultOfGeneratorT
classes.description: Type alias for the return type of a GeneratorType functor.

classes.name: AreGeneratorsWithTheSameReturnType
classes.description: A metafunction to check if multiple generator functors have the same return type.

classes.name: AreEquivalenceClassesOfTheSameType
classes.description: A metafunction to verify if multiple EquivalenceClassType instances contain generator functors with the same return type.

classes.name: ForEachParameter
classes.description: Executes a given function on each parameter passed.

classes.name: ForEachTupleElement
classes.description: Executes a function on each element of a tuple.

classes.name: ForEveryTwo
classes.description: Executes a function on every pair of elements within a tuple, including pairs of the same element.

classes.name: InsertEach
classes.description: Inserts multiple values into a container.

classes.name: If
classes.description: A template struct with a static Invoke method that conditionally executes a functor based on a boolean template parameter.
